name: hermes-labs
description: Hermes Labs agent plugins: deterministic quality checks, safety guardrails, session recovery, and workflow tools.

plugins.name: hermes-blind
plugins.description: Local recovery anchors for Claude Code and Codex sessions, plus evidence-gated evaluation prompts.

plugins.name: lintlang
plugins.description: Runs the released LintLang CLI on demand as a portable audit skill, with a separate automatic post-edit hook for Claude Code.

plugins.name: rule-audit
plugins.description: On-demand static analysis of AI system prompts for contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities, and meta-paradoxes.

plugins.name: hermeneutic-gate
plugins.description: Legacy advisory Stop-hook bundle for the fixed English gate; current Claude Stop compatibility is not certified in v0.1.7.

plugins.name: little-canary
plugins.description: Screens inbound prompts through a local Little Canary service before the host sends them to the main model.

plugins.name: claude-trash-guard
plugins.description: Blocks permanent-delete shell commands and redirects the agent to a recoverable trash workflow.

plugins.name: agent-signage
plugins.description: Reports actionable git-state facts before file operations when a checkout is behind its upstream.

plugins.name: hermes-jailbench
plugins.description: Jailbreak regression benchmark for LLM endpoints with repeatable known-pattern attacks and deterministic scoring.

plugins.name: agent-kickstart
plugins.description: Guided, project-local first experience that helps beginners start making something real.

plugins.name: intent-verify
plugins.description: Maps markdown acceptance items to explicit implementation evidence for advisory spec-drift checks.

plugins.name: quick-gate-python
plugins.description: Runs the deterministic pygate Python quality gate and reads its gate-result/v1 verdict.

plugins.name: quick-gate-js
plugins.description: Runs the released quick-gate JavaScript and TypeScript quality gate and reads its gate-result/v1 verdict.

plugins.name: hermes-gate
plugins.description: Receipt-bound completion rail with session-start guidance, advisory cached checks, and boundary enforcement.
